author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Sean Stone to expose one of the most disturbing and deliberately buried scandals in American history — the Franklin case. What started as a financial fraud at a Nebraska credit union rapidly unravelled into a deeply sinister network of child trafficking connecting vulnerable young people to some of the most powerful figures in American politics and business. Russell and Sean break down the evidence, the witnesses who were silenced and why every attempt to bring this case to public light was systematically shut down by the very institutions designed to protect the innocent.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Dr Drew to open up about the deeply personal story behind his new book and why he felt compelled to write it. Russell explains that the book is not just a project but a living testament to the transformation that faith in Jesus Christ brought to his life — a document of what it actually looks like when someone surrenders to God after decades of addiction, chaos and searching. Dr Drew responds with genuine curiosity and warmth as Russell breaks down why he believes this book could change lives the way his faith changed his.
